scope: Read-only data1 post-hoc failure diagnosis. No training, inference, algorithm edit, offset fitting, reference replacement, or output correction.
units: HR: bpm; ACC: frequency Hz multiplied by 60, not heart rate.

protocol.raw_time_axis: device_time_ns already expressed in absolute Unix ns by collector; no receipt-delay correction
protocol.time_mapping_limit: host receipt minus raw device endpoint mixes clock offset and packet delay; no verified sample-to-notification physiological latency
protocol.window_source: all time_s in existing predictions/pos_heart_rate.csv, independent of accepted status
protocol.resampling: linear interpolation on recorded sample times to one common video-UTC grid; reject gaps > 3 median raw intervals
protocol.spectrum: linear detrend, Hann periodogram, nfft=8192; choose maximum only within fixed 0.7–3.5 Hz
protocol.coherence: Welch magnitude-squared coherence, 4 s Hann segments, 50% overlap, 4 segments per 10 s window, nfft=8192; descriptive, no significance threshold
protocol.warning: zero-padding does not increase the information resolution of a 10 s window; overlapping windows are not independent

comparison_definition.acc_axes: All four original audit axes/norm retained; no best axis selected.
comparison_definition.half_frequency: Explicit diagnostic arithmetic comparison only; no evidence this is a physiological fundamental, no folded output rescoring.
comparison_definition.dependence: Overlapping windows are not independent subjects/trials.

cpace.seed: unmodified author default: Forehead GREEN PSD; no external seed
cpace.roi_segment_rule: constant available ROI set; Forehead required plus at least one cheek
cpace.primary_waveform: fixed Forehead cardiac_signals; no ROI averaging or selection
cpace.final_hr: V2.2 legacy estimate on CSV-roundtripped saved waveform; 42–210 bpm, 10 s windows, 1 s step, offline DP
cpace.provenance: ALL used ROIs observed and ANY used ROI interpolated; masked waveform samples have both flags false

cpace_no_homodyne.seed: unmodified author default: Forehead GREEN PSD; no external seed
cpace_no_homodyne.roi_segment_rule: constant available ROI set; Forehead required plus at least one cheek
cpace_no_homodyne.primary_waveform: fixed Forehead cardiac_signals; no ROI averaging or selection
cpace_no_homodyne.final_hr: V2.2 legacy estimate on CSV-roundtripped saved waveform; 42–210 bpm, 10 s windows, 1 s step, offline DP
cpace_no_homodyne.provenance: ALL used ROIs observed and ANY used ROI interpolated; masked waveform samples have both flags false

rhythm.crop: V22 tracked normalized face box, 1.5 expansion, clamp at frame edges
rhythm.normalization: one scalar mean/std(ddof=0) over all real cropped frames of each bounded segment, including discarded tail
rhythm.clips: 160 frames, nonoverlapping, incomplete segment tail discarded
rhythm.prediction_normalization: per clip torch mean/std correction=1, as author trainer
rhythm.sample_clock: original video fps, no 30 Hz resampling
rhythm.postprocessing: project third-order zero-phase Butterworth 42-210 bpm per contiguous predicted segment
rhythm.final_hr: legacy saved-waveform 10s/1s local peak and offline DP

evidence: gap10 DP is near half the contemporaneous original ACC norm spectral peak, while Rhythm DP is near that peak itself.
Default cPACE DP is 51-64 bpm with a fixed video-GREEN seed of 49.129208893328524 bpm; it is a different low-frequency failure pattern.
The no-homodyne diagnostic branch has high-frequency DP outputs and larger error than default cPACE at the same 38 accepted windows.
Rhythm local spectral peaks alternate lower and higher frequencies; the saved-waveform offline DP readout stays at the higher branch.
inferences_not_established: Periodic-motion contamination or harmonic branch selection are candidate explanations, not established physiological or causal findings.
The GREEN seed/homodyne path may contribute to cPACE low-frequency output; the ablation does not isolate seed correctness or prove causation.
No inference that Polar notification HR is wrong, or that 94/188/half-ACC is the true HR.
No evidence separating domain shift, crop changes, physiological harmonics, mechanical signal, or DP preference uniquely.
Results are a project adapter and common-window readout trial, not a full reproduction of original author benchmark or fused-CUDA performance.
